cohort: 101 pregnant women in the 24 to 28 weeks of gestation period undergoing GDM screening at public sector hospitals in Pakistan.
finding: The study found an increased prevalence of gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, and cesarean deliveries in women with GDM, and an increased risk of macrosomia, neonatal hypoglycemia, and NICU admissions for infants of GDM mothers, suggesting early GDM detection and treatment can improve outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with GDM had an increased prevalence of cesarean deliveries.
